# oscilloscope-mcp

> FastMCP 3.2+ MCP server for USB PC oscilloscopes (screenless frontends).

## Summary

Control PicoScope, Hantek, or built-in simulator from AI agents. Capture waveforms, export CSV, measure Vpp/frequency/duty/rise time.

## Tools (portmanteau)

- scope_device: list, connect, disconnect, status, capabilities, backends
- scope_configure: channel, get, simulator_profile
- scope_trigger: set, get, arm, force
- scope_capture: single, preview, export_csv, export_summary, last
- scope_measure: all, vpp, frequency, duty, rise_time, fresh
- scope_help: discover, tool_help, status, quickstart, faq, hardware_guide

## Quickstart

scope_device(operation="connect", device_id="sim-001")
scope_capture(operation="single", sample_rate_hz=100000, sample_count=2000)
scope_measure(operation="all", channel_id="A")

## Backends

- simulator: always available
- picoscope: uv sync --extra picoscope + PicoSDK
- hantek: uv sync --extra hantek + libusb

## Install

uv sync --extra dev
uv run python -m oscilloscope_mcp --stdio

## MCPB (Claude Desktop)

- `manifest.json` at repo root
- Build: `just mcpb-pack` → `dist/oscilloscope-mcp-v0.1.0.mcpb`
- Drag `.mcpb` to Claude Desktop or use stdio in Cursor `mcp.json`

## Discovery

- glama.json — Glama / fleet registry
- GET http://127.0.0.1:10936/api/capabilities

## Ports

HTTP backend: 10936
Webapp frontend: 10937
